HISTORICAL PURCHASE SUPPORT

Refund Policy

Updated September 26, 2026

PDF downloads are now free

ResumeNowOnline no longer accepts payment for PDF downloads. This page remains available to support earlier purchases.

Contact support →

1. Current service

Resume creation, editing, preview, and PDF download are currently provided without charge. There is no checkout or paid download product on the website.

2. Earlier purchases

If you paid for a Resume Export Pack before free downloads were introduced, we will continue to review eligible support and refund requests under the terms that applied when you purchased.

3. How to request help

Email support@resume-now.online and include:

  • The email address used for the earlier purchase
  • The order number shown on your receipt
  • The purchase date and a short explanation of the request

Do not email card numbers, passwords, or identity documents.

4. Processing

Approved refunds for historical orders are returned to the original payment method by the payment provider. Processing times depend on the bank or payment method.

5. Consumer rights

This policy does not limit any mandatory refund, cancellation, or withdrawal rights available under applicable consumer law.

6. Contact

For historical order or delivery support, email support@resume-now.online. For the current free export experience, see Free PDF export.
